title: SVG tracer benchmarks
affiliation: Daniel Voshart develops Monotrace. The local comparisons were executed for this project; they are not independent evaluations.

dino.label: DINO ↑
dino.description: DINOv2 image-feature similarity. Higher is better; this is not a percentage accuracy or success rate.

median_boundary.label: Median boundary ↓
median_boundary.description: Median of per-image symmetric boundary errors in native input pixels.

mean_boundary.label: Mean boundary ↓
mean_boundary.description: Mean of per-image symmetric boundary errors. For font runs, an empty output against visible reference carries a 256 px penalty; blank against blank is zero.

iou.label: Ink IoU ↑
iou.description: Mean intersection-over-union of thresholded ink masks. Higher is better.

segments.label: Segments ↓
segments.description: Median line/curve segment count. Full-run counts use successful nonempty outputs. Fewer segments do not establish better reconstruction.

no_output.label: No output ↓
no_output.description: Visible reference images with no ink at scoring resolution, including explicit trace errors.

trace_errors.label: Trace errors ↓
trace_errors.description: Explicit unsuccessful conversion attempts; an empty SVG can still be a completed conversion.

topology.label: Topology flags ↓
topology.description: Images whose sampled component/hole counts differ. Resolution-dependent; not an exact vector topology or fabrication check.

dino_cosine.label: DINO ↑
dino_cosine.description: DINOv2 feature cosine similarity reported by the OmniSVG authors. Do not assume the local font scorer’s rescaling or preprocessing.

ssim.label: SSIM ↑
ssim.description: Published structural similarity of reconstructed and reference rasters; compare within the selected protocol.

lpips.label: LPIPS ↓
lpips.description: Published learned perceptual image patch distance; compare within the selected protocol.

mse.label: MSE ↓
mse.description: Published pixel mean squared error. Resolution, normalization and aggregation remain source-specific; not the local boundary error in pixels.

tokens_k.label: Tokens ↓
tokens_k.description: Reported average SVG token length in thousands, using the Qwen2.5-VL tokenizer. Rounded source values; not bytes, paths or curve segments.

paths.label: Paths ↓
paths.description: Reported average number of SVG paths, not the local median curve-segment count. Fewer paths do not by themselves prove better reconstruction.

reported_seconds.label: Reported time ↓
reported_seconds.description: Time cost reported in LayerTracer Table 2. Inference hardware and timing boundaries were not independently verified; not a cross-study speed comparison.

monotrace.name: Monotrace
monotrace.note: Fixed kernel source revision 456eebfee1bec816e67ea9d775177af872d09859. Private implementation; no fitting policy was tuned on these runs.

potrace.note: 50% threshold PBM input, no dithering. Original C implementation, without the SVG Tools preprocessing or search harness.

vtracer.name: VTracer
vtracer.note: SVG generator identifies the internal engine as 0.6.12. Binary mode, other Python defaults.

layertracer_benchmark.title: LayerTracer · Section 4.1 · benchmark selection

runs.label: SVG-Fonts · full test set
runs.method: Original SVG framing, white background, no crop or automatic levels. Matched resvg 1024 px geometry renders, reported in native pixels. DINO uses resvg 256 px scoring images and the pinned DINOv2-base FP32 model.
runs.caveat: Monotrace has lower median error, while Potrace has a lower all-case mean after missing-output penalties. The published paper scores use a different or unverified pipeline.

rows.note: No explicit errors. One subpixel reference produces an empty SVG. Four completely white reference canvases are also retained.
Two explicit errors (unresolved span and contour budget), plus two completed empty SVGs against visible reference. Four visible references have no scoring ink in total.

runs.label: SVG-Fonts · 256-image pilot
runs.summary: 256 hash-selected test images · 256 px inputs · measured 4 November 2026
runs.method: Lowest 256 SHA256 values of monotrace-external-first-pass-v1: plus the source filename. Matched resvg scoring and the same fixed kernel as the full run.
runs.caveat: The pilot is contained within the full test set. Do not count it as an additional independent dataset. One empty VTracer result incurs a 256 px penalty and inflates its mean boundary error.

rows.note: Native settings were fixed before the full-set expansion.
Native settings were fixed before the full-set expansion.

runs.label: PolyFit · binary inputs
runs.summary: 116 original monochrome inputs · native resolution, generally around 32/64 px
runs.method: Matched resvg output renders at each original raster size. Geometry scores compare with the original raster pixels, not an original vector master.
runs.caveat: Measures raster reconstruction. It does not establish recovery of the artist’s intended curves, and the PolyFit algorithm itself was not run.

runs.summary: CVPR 2025 published table · StarVector authors’ evaluation

runs.caveat: These scores form their own published comparison group. They cannot be used to rank Monotrace against StarVector or AutoTrace using the maintainer-run numbers.

runs.label: Layer-wise vectorization · LayerTracer report
runs.sample_count_note: Section 4.1 reports 50 image inputs; exact cases and LayerSVG/Noto-Emoji proportions remain unverified.
runs.method: Published raster-to-layered-SVG experiment, with default baseline settings as described in Section 4.1. MSE and average path counts are copied from Table 2. Text-to-SVG Table 1 and the nine-frame ablation in Table 3 are excluded. Exact scoring normalization and evaluation file list are unverified.
runs.caveat: Published by the LayerTracer authors. Path counts are not curve-segment counts. This study was not reproduced here and does not include Monotrace; its pixel MSE is not comparable with font boundary error.
